name: Win Win Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Win Win Precision Technology Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated entities, specializes in the production and global distribution of solar photovoltaic modules and semiconductor components. The company maintains a market presence across Taiwan, Europe, and various international territories. Its operations are divided into two primary segments: Solar Energy and Semiconductor. Within its Semiconductor division, Win Win Precision provides a range of services, including system design, planning, and integration, alongside supplying consumable equipment parts and offering maintenance support. The Solar Energy segment is dedicated to the design and development of solar power systems, as well as the active management of solar power plants. The company was founded in 2003 and has its main office situated in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
